## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:web` and `cargo check` (in `src-tauri`) pass
- [ ] Tried the change in `npm run dev`
- [ ] User-facing text added in every language of `src/lib/i18n.ts`
- [ ] Docs (`README.md`, `docs/`) updated if behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* for user-visible changes
